defects.evidence: Line 203: "every command in sections 3.1-3.2 has a `## Unattended mode` section". AC-1.1 is still a P1 check over all 3.1-3.2 commands (P2-P4 commands and pr-submit included); the P1 scope (line 159) still says the flag is accepted by every such command, so P1 edits ~14 commands but asserts all.

Line 159: "refuse it with an error until their P2 or P4 change lands". Only auggie-review, task, pr-submit and post-release fail closed; other gated commands (cleanup, improve, cli-eval, cli-portify, implement, tdd, reflect, etc.) still accept --unattended in P1 with gates unconverted until P2/P4, and section 2.3 does not tell the coordinator to pass the flag only to converted commands.

Line 112: "none: use it as a step inside another worker's brief, not as its own Task". load row unchanged and still in the P1 Commands cell, while AC-1.1 (line 203) and AC-1.2 (line 204) still apply to every 3.1-3.2 / P1 command; Decisions table still calls a report file an unrequested addition.

Line 79: "The only command changes are the small fixes in the last column.". init-lite was added to the P1 Commands cell (line 159) but brainstorm (fix None, line 84) is still in no phase and line 76/AC-1.1 still require the section for every 3.1 command.

Line 159: "fixes to adversarial, cleanup-audit, index-repo, workflow, init-lite (M1)". Only init-lite was added; tdd, troubleshoot, release-split, reflect and brainstorm contract work is still assigned to no phase cell while line 79 says Phase 1 adds the contract.

Line 62: "Where the output option names a file (tdd, init-lite), the contract sits beside that file.". A location rule now exists but gives no filename or per-file naming (so two outputs in one folder can share a contract), and spec-panel's added --output type and the AC-2.2 `--output <file>` example are not reconciled.
defects.ambiguity_note: 'beside' is not a concrete path rule

defects.evidence: Line 62: "adversarial's is `<output>/adversarial/return-contract.yaml` (`INV-A:60`)". WC-4 now names adversarial's subpath as an exception and the adversarial row (line 83) and AC-1.4 (line 206) use the same path.
